scripts.features:
💬 Community & Support
Free Keys on Discord: Join our Discord server to get free keys, updates, support, and exclusive scripts! (https://discord.gg/Y7bz5Wnxv)
​🌾 Advanced Auto Farm System
• Auto Egg Farm: Scans and farms target high-tier rare eggs (Volcanic, Cherub, Solaris, Black Hole, Bloom, Galaxy) using an optimized priority engine.
• Advanced Anti-Steal Filter: Ignores eggs currently held by other players or located inside other ranches (60-stud boundary check).

• Multi-Target Egg Selector: Switch target presets (All, Specific Eggs Only, Top Tier) on the fly without toggling farm off.
• Grid-Based Auto Place: Optional toggle that neatly arranges eggs across your Ranch using an 8x8 corner-to-corner layout with anti-stuck timeout protection.
• Auto Hatch: Auto-fires prompt and remote triggers to hatch ready eggs on your ranch.
• Auto Rebirth: Automatically executes rebirths whenever player requirements are met.
• Smart Idle Hover: Safely hovers above your Ranch and monitors spawns when no target eggs are active.
• Universal Interaction: Auto-fires TouchInterests, ProximityPrompts, and ClickDetectors upon arrival.
​🔮 Visuals & ESP
• Giant 3D Egg ESP: High-visibility billboard labels visible across the entire map through walls.
• Custom-Colored Highlights: Fill and outline highlights mapped directly to egg rarity colors.
• Real-Time Clean Cache: Dynamic cleanup that removes indicators once an egg is collected or despawned.
​🚀 Teleport & Ultra-Smooth Movement
• Physics-Bypassed Flight: Utilizes platform-stand and vector dampening to eliminate camera jitter, stuttering, and physics lag at high speeds.
• Adjustable Flight Speed: Fully customizable flying velocity directly inside the GUI.
• Fly to Ranch: Fast, safe vector flight directly to your ranch's ground alignment without void falling.
• Custom Base Saving: Save any custom CFrame location and teleport back smoothly at any time.
• CFrame Speed Boost: RenderStepped walkspeed modifier that bypasses default Humanoid speed limits.
• Safe Noclip Engine: Automatic collision management during flight routines with clean physics resets upon landing.
​⚙️ UI, Performance & Security
• Extreme Optimization: Built-in 1-click potato graphics mode (disables shadows, post-processing, textures, particles) for maximum FPS.
• FPS Unlocker: Built-in 999 FPS cap bypass for supported executors.
• Panda Auth V4: Streamlined Key System with instant clipboard copying and direct menu loading upon validation.
• Modern Tabbed GUI: Fully draggable, minimizable interface with smooth tween animations and color-coded active toggle buttons.
